items.headline: 2026 college football SP+ rankings for all 138 FBS teams
items.description: The updated SP+ rankings, plus strength of schedule and résumé SP+, after this weekend's results.

items.headline: It's Week 10 and everything remains up for grabs in college football
items.description: There were plenty of top-ranked matchups in Week 10, but the results didn't solidify anything.

items.headline: Alabama's execution exposes LSU's gap between effort and results
items.description: The SEC Now crew breaks down how the No. 5 Crimson Tide make their opportunities count in the win over LSU and what the No. 14 Tigers can do to turn all that effort into production.

items.headline: Oregon's 'Shoe Ducks' jab at Ohio State tops college football Week 10 trolls
items.description: All the top postgame jabs from around college football in Week 10, led by Oregon's post aimed at Ohio State.

items.headline: LSU flops on fourth downs in 'really disappointing' loss
items.description: In a matchup of CFP hopefuls, No. 14 LSU outgained No. 5 Alabama by 172 yards but was undone by poor red zone and fourth-down offense, losing at home 31-13 to fall to 6-3 this season, an outcome Tigers coach Lane Kiffin called "really disappointing."

items.headline: Russell passes for 3 TDs to propel No. 9 Alabama past No. 15 LSU, 31-13
items.description: — Keelon Russell pushed through an ankle injury to pass for three touchdowns, Alabama made several pivotal fourth-down stops and the ninth-ranked Crimson Tide pulled away for a 31-13 victory over No. 15 LSU on Saturday.
